people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.
translations.bsb: You did not go up to the gaps or restore the wall around the house of Israel so that it would stand in the battle on the Day of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.
translations.asv: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the day of Jehovah.
